description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/PauseToReview. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Moves a scheduled pending product to manual review so it is not published at its scheduled time. ReadOnly: false. RequiresConfirmation: true. RequiresChannel: true. Use when: The user asks to pause, hold or stop a scheduled pending product so it is reviewed before publication. SearchTerms: pause pending listing, move pending listing to review, hold scheduled publication, stop scheduled listing. NegativeUseCases: Do not use for active or terminated listings. Input: [FromBody] rq: Request.ListNowRequest. Id is the first variation ID, not its parent ListingId. Resolve the attached product or GetPending listingId through Listing/GetListings with ListingIds and Projection=Identifiers in the selected channel, then use variations[0].id, as HGRWeb Pause does. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: BaseResponse.Success is true when the product moved to review. It is false when the variation belongs to another channel, the product is not scheduled for its first listing, or its scheduled time is less than 3 minutes away. Search terms: searchproduct pausetoreview. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_searchproduct_pausetoreview
title: Post Searchproduct Pausetoreview
